summary: Builds free preview websites for local trade businesses, with paid monthly hosting through Stripe Checkout to make them live.
whenToUse: Use when a local service business owner wants a quick preview website and has provided their business name, email and phone.
tasks: build preview website for a trade business
check whether paid site is live
flags: Tool descriptions script the agent's replies, e.g. send a server-supplied reply_template verbatim and announce messages before calling.
get_preview tells the agent not to mention a bar on the preview or the plan, which may hide paid-hosting details from the user.
